action_items: FIX (main agent, HIGH): The Google Maps JS API removed the Heatmap Layer in v3.65 (current loader pins v=weekly which is now 3.65+). The 'Heat View' feature using HeatmapLayer from @react-google-maps/api will always throw. Options: (a) Pin the loader to v=3.64 or earlier (short-term workaround only, deprecation will fully break), (b) Migrate to the new google.maps.visualization-replacement or implement custom heatmap with deck.gl/Google Maps DataLayer, (c) Disable/hide the 'Heat View' button until a replacement is implemented. Recommended: hide the heat-view-toggle and remove HeatmapLayer JSX until a replacement is ready, OR wrap HeatmapLayer in an ErrorBoundary that catches the throw silently in dev.
OPTIONAL (low): Address deprecated google.maps.Marker warning by migrating to AdvancedMarkerElement.

OPTIONAL HARDENING: GooglePlacesInput.js still injects a raw <script> maps.googleapis.com loader different from useJsApiLoader. Consolidate to a single loader to avoid 'multiple times' warnings on pages mounting both.

HeatmapLayer is dead code as of GMaps JS API v3.65. The 'visualization' library still loads but the HeatmapLayer constructor itself throws. This was masked previously by the earlier SVG-path crash that fired first; now that the SVG-path crash is fixed, the Heatmap deprecation surfaces.

react-scripts dev overlay continues to show generic 'Script error.' for cross-origin throws — consider adding a window.onerror filter for maps.googleapis.com to avoid noisy dev overlays for cross-origin GMaps issues.

rca of the issue: PRIMARY FIX (SVG path) verified — root cause from iteration_127 was the implicit-arc shorthand with packed flag digits which Google Maps' util.js parser (QCa) could not split. Replacement uses Material 'directions_car' path that only uses M/L/C/c/s/h/v/z commands (no 'a' arc commands), so no parser ambiguity. NEW ISSUE root cause: Google Maps JavaScript API v3.65 (released late 2025) fully removed the Heatmap Layer (already deprecated since v3.62, May 2025). @react-google-maps/api's HeatmapLayer component still instantiates the now-missing constructor, which throws 'The Heatmap Layer functionality in the Maps JavaScript API is no longer available'. The throw bubbles to window.onerror; CRA dev overlay shows generic 'Script error.' because the throw is cross-origin from maps.googleapis.com without CORS attributes on the loader. Mitigation: remove HeatmapLayer JSX, hide the Heat View toggle, or implement a custom heatmap via canvas / deck.gl / DataLayer.
